activities.activity_description: Create quick start guide (U1), architecture overview with visual aids and scripts (U5), and up-to-date documentation for v1.0 with redirection to v0.6 for stable platform (U6). Includes writing, diagram creation, and script development.
Document the structure, fields, and values of the new-channel configuration transaction (U2). Provide examples and explanation.
Design and implement the ability to upgrade a peer without data loss in response to protocol changes (U3). Includes handling chaincode lifecycle upgrades and applying patches/fixes.
Fix ledger code and unit tests that still use old block structure (U4). Remove explicit dependency of ledger unit tests on MSP security-related components.
Add validation logic to ensure only LCCC or normal chaincode can be invoked (U7). Implement as a sanity check in the invocation flow.
Develop a Node.js SDK to allow applications to interact with the blockchain (U8). Includes API design, implementation, documentation, and example code.
Integrate all developed components, run comprehensive integration tests, fix any issues, and verify that all user stories are satisfied.
Perform self-review of all code and documentation, address any remaining issues, ensure adherence to coding standards, and finalize deliverables.
